expanded_width.label: Expanded width
expanded_width.description: How wide the island grows when an event arrives, in pixels.

expand_ms.label: Animation duration
expand_ms.description: Length of the expand and collapse animation in milliseconds.

hold_ms.label: Hold time
hold_ms.description: How long the island stays expanded after an event before it collapses again.

watch_media.label: React to media
watch_media.description: Expand when the track or playback status changes. Requires playerctl.

watch_volume.label: React to volume
watch_volume.description: Expand and show a bar when the output volume changes. Requires pactl and wpctl.

show_album_art.label: Show album art
show_album_art.description: Use the track's cover image instead of the playback icon. Only local artwork is used.

expand_on_hover.label: Expand on hover
expand_on_hover.description: Keep the island expanded while the pointer rests on it.

float_island.label: Floating island
float_island.description: Show events on a floating capsule below the bar instead of widening the bar widget.

float_width.label: Floating island width
float_width.description: How wide the floating island grows when an event arrives, in pixels.

watch_brightness.label: React to brightness
watch_brightness.description: Expand and show a bar when the screen brightness changes. Requires udevadm.

watch_mic.label: React to microphone
watch_mic.description: Expand when the microphone is muted or its level changes. Requires pactl and wpctl.

media_controls.label: Media card on hover
media_controls.description: Open a media card with album art, progress and transport buttons when the pointer rests on the floating island, or when the bar widget is clicked.

open_width.label: Media card width
open_width.description: How wide the media card is when the island opens, in pixels.
